review.title: Choose the installation path
review.text: For a supported in-place upgrade, verify the edition, architecture, language, applications and drivers before choosing to keep files and apps. A clean install creates a fresh OS and requires an independent copy of anything the user needs. A repair installation targets an existing installation. Record user preferences and recovery keys, check vendor support dates and test a restore before work starts.

review.title: Trace how the installer starts
review.text: A single PC can boot from USB or other bootable media. Network boot can use PXE to load a deployment environment; a prepared image standardizes many PCs. Zero-touch describes an automated workflow once its prerequisites are met. Internet recovery retrieves vendor content. An internal recovery partition depends on a readable disk. Multiboot offers a choice of installed operating systems.

review.title: Distinguish disk layout from file system
review.text: GUID Partition Table (GPT) and Master Boot Record (MBR) are disk partition styles. MBR allows four primary partition entries and addresses about 2 TiB with 512-byte logical sectors. GPT supports larger disks and more partitions. Formatting a partition creates a file system such as NTFS. A normal Windows UEFI installation uses GPT on the startup disk. If Setup cannot see a disk that firmware detects, check controller configuration and the approved storage driver before changing partitions.

review.title: Reconstruct a restore chain
review.text: A full backup copies the selected data. An incremental captures changes since the most recent backup in the chain. Restoring Tuesday after a Sunday full with daily incrementals requires Sunday, Monday and Tuesday in order. A differential captures changes since the last full, so Sunday plus Tuesday's differential suffice. A synthetic full is assembled from stored backups.

review.title: Test recovery before relying on it
review.text: Keep three copies in total, on two media types, with one copy offsite. A grandfather-father-son rotation retains generations, often monthly, weekly and daily. An alternative-location restore lets you open the recovered file without overwriting the original. Test regularly and after changes; record the restore point, destination and verification result.

sources: Microsoft Learn: Windows Setup and partition styles

cards.prompt: What is PXE used for during deployment?
cards.answer: Preboot Execution Environment starts a machine from the network so it can load boot files from a deployment service.
A prepared OS and software baseline can be applied consistently to multiple devices.

cards.prompt: When can an in-place upgrade preserve applications?
cards.answer: When the source and target follow a supported upgrade path and Setup offers the option to keep apps and files.
It builds a fresh OS environment. Existing applications must be reinstalled and user data restored as needed.
GUID Partition Table, the disk partition layout normally used by Windows when booting in UEFI mode.

cards.prompt: How does formatting differ from partitioning?
cards.answer: Partitioning defines regions on a disk. Formatting prepares a volume with a file system.

cards.prompt: Why might an internal recovery partition be unavailable?
cards.answer: A failed internal disk can take the recovery environment and user volume offline together.

cards.prompt: What must you retain for a traditional incremental restore?
cards.answer: The base full and every required incremental in the chain through the selected restore point.

cards.prompt: Which two backup sets recover Thursday with daily differential backups?
cards.answer: Restore the full backup used as Thursday’s differential base, followed by Thursday’s differential. Check the backup catalog for the matching base.

cards.prompt: Where does a synthetic full get its data?
cards.answer: Previously stored backup data, such as a full and subsequent incrementals, are combined into a new full.
Grandfather-father-son retains generations of backups on different schedules.

cards.prompt: What loss can the offsite copy in 3-2-1 address?
cards.answer: A site-wide event that damages the workstation and all local backup media.

quiz.prompt: A Windows installer started in UEFI mode expects the system disk partition style abbreviated ____.
quiz.explanation: GPT describes the layout. NTFS describes a volume's file system.

quiz.prompt: An imaging technician selects network boot. The firmware obtains boot information from a deployment service before a local OS starts. What three-letter boot environment is this? ____
quiz.explanation: PXE can load deployment boot files over a suitably configured network.

quiz.prompt: A supported OS migration that keeps installed applications is an ____ upgrade.
quiz.explanation: Setup must support the source-to-target path and preservation option.

quiz.prompt: In the deployment terms used by objective 1.2, an automated rollout that needs no technician input at the workstation is called ____ deployment.
quiz.explanation: Automation handles the installation steps after prerequisites are met.

quiz.prompt: A backup that always records all changes since the last full is a ____ backup.
quiz.explanation: Only the base full and the selected differential are needed for that recovery point.

quiz.prompt: In a traditional chain, a backup of changes since the immediately preceding backup is an ____ backup.
quiz.explanation: Each link depends on earlier backup data.

quiz.prompt: A full backup assembled from existing backup sets is called a ____ full.
quiz.explanation: The repository combines stored data to create the new full.

quiz.prompt: In 3-2-1, one copy must be kept ____ to protect against loss of the entire local site.
quiz.explanation: Separating a copy geographically reduces exposure to the same site disaster.

worksheet.prompt: A laptop's internal disk has failed completely. Compare a recovery partition on that disk with bootable USB recovery media.
worksheet.key: The failed disk can make its recovery partition inaccessible. Bootable USB provides an independent starting point after checking firmware boot support.

worksheet.prompt: Identify what each term describes: GPT, MBR and NTFS.
worksheet.key: GPT and MBR are disk partition styles. NTFS is a file system used on a volume.

worksheet.prompt: A user wants an upgrade that retains apps. Name three checks before accepting the job.
worksheet.key: Verify a supported edition, language and architecture path, test required apps and drivers, and verify a restorable backup including user data and settings.

worksheet.prompt: Explain how network boot, image deployment and zero-touch relate in a fleet rollout.
worksheet.key: Network boot loads the deployment environment, the image supplies the standard workstation build, and automation can complete configuration without a technician at each desk.

worksheet.prompt: Write two restore lists for Wednesday. Sunday was a full backup. The next three days used either all incrementals or all differentials.
worksheet.key: Incremental: Sunday full, then Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday incrementals. Differential: Sunday full plus Wednesday differential.

worksheet.prompt: Describe a 3-2-1 arrangement and explain the different purpose of GFS rotation.
worksheet.key: Keep the live files, a local backup and an offsite backup across two media types. GFS retains several ages of restore point, so a recent bad change need not replace every older copy.

worksheet.prompt: Microsoft's Setup article describes a GPT-style mismatch. Setup was booted in UEFI mode and sees the disk. What two facts would you record before planning a change?
worksheet.key: Record the boot mode and current target partition style, for example UEFI and MBR. Confirm backup and restore readiness before any conversion or repartitioning.
worksheet.source: Microsoft Learn: Windows Setup and partition styles

worksheet.prompt: Design a restore test for a document that is currently being edited. Give a destination and a success criterion.
worksheet.key: Restore the selected version to an alternative folder, open it and compare its contents with the expected version. Record the result without disturbing the working copy.
worksheet.source: Application exercise: use the recovery test review
